name: Sarah Johnson
title: Senior Frontend Engineer & Educator
bio: Sarah has 10+ years of experience building React applications at companies like Meta and Airbnb. She is passionate about making modern web development accessible to learners of all levels. Her teaching style focuses on real-world projects and building intuition, not just memorizing syntax.

name: Michael Chen
title: Lead Product Designer at DesignCo
bio: Michael has designed products used by millions at companies including Dropbox and Figma. With a background in both visual art and psychology, he brings a uniquely human-centered approach to UI/UX education. He has trained hundreds of designers who now work at top tech companies.

name: Dr. Emily Rodriguez
title: Data Scientist & ML Research Lead
bio: Dr. Rodriguez holds a PhD in Computer Science from MIT and has published over 20 papers on machine learning and neural network architectures. She previously led the ML infrastructure team at Google and now dedicates her time to democratizing AI education through clear, practical teaching.

name: James Wilson
title: Backend Architect & Open Source Contributor
bio: James has spent 12 years building scalable backend systems, from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. He is an active open source contributor with 15k+ GitHub stars across his projects. His Node.js expertise spans REST APIs, microservices, and real-time applications.

name: Aisha Patel
title: CSS Architecture Specialist
bio: Aisha is a self-taught developer who turned her obsession with CSS into a career spanning 9 years. She has given talks at CSSConf and contributed to major design systems at Shopify and GitHub. She believes great CSS is an art form, and her courses show you how to write it with confidence.

name: Omar Khalid
title: DevOps Lead & Kubernetes Certified Expert
bio: Omar is a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) with 11 years of experience running infrastructure at scale. He built and managed the CI/CD pipelines for fintech platforms processing millions of transactions daily. His teaching philosophy: understand why before you memorize how.

name: Laura Kim
title: iOS Engineer at Apple
bio: Laura has been writing Swift since its release in 2014 and has shipped over 20 apps to the App Store, collectively earning millions of downloads. She works as an iOS engineer at Apple during the day and teaches evenings and weekends because she loves helping people build their first app.

name: Marcus Thompson
title: Cybersecurity Consultant & Ethical Hacker
bio: Marcus is a certified ethical hacker (CEH) and CompTIA Security+ holder with a decade of experience in penetration testing and security audits for banks and government agencies. He has disclosed vulnerabilities in major tech platforms and is a strong advocate for security awareness education.

name: Nina Kovacs
title: Full-Stack TypeScript Architect
bio: Nina is the creator of two popular TypeScript open source libraries and has helped teams migrate large codebases to type-safe architectures. She is a core contributor to the tRPC ecosystem and a frequent speaker at TypeScript conferences across Europe and North America.

name: David Park
title: Digital Marketing Director & Growth Strategist
bio: David has managed $50M+ in ad spend across Google, Meta, and programmatic platforms. He founded and scaled two e-commerce brands from zero to seven figures before transitioning into education. His courses are the most practical in the field — no theory, just strategies that actually work.
